content:
Another streaming platform has raised its prices. Peacock has increased the prices of its three subscription plans, with monthly increases of up to $3 or annual increases of up to $30.

Peacock's latest price hike brings the Premium Plus monthly fee to $20. However, Apple's bundle discount offers remain unchanged for now.

Peacock's monthly fee has now increased by $3

The streaming platform stated: "This price adjustment enables Peacock to continue providing viewers with the best experience, maintain market competitiveness, and keep delivering unique content across various genres."

Under Peacock's new pricing, the entry-level Select plan increases from $7.99 to $8.99 per month, and from $79.99 to $89.99 per year.

Peacock Premium rises from $10.99 to $12.99 per month, with the annual fee also increasing from $109.99 to $129.99.

Peacock Premium Plus, which is the near-ad-free plan and supports offline downloads, now costs $19.99 per month and $199.99 per year, up from the previous $16.99 monthly and $169.99 annual fees.

Among the plans, Peacock Premium sees the largest increase at approximately 18%. Annual plans essentially work out to about 10 months at the new monthly price (excluding any limited-time offers).

The new pricing takes effect today (August 18) and applies to new and resubscribing users.

Existing subscribers will be charged at the new rate starting from their first billing date on or after September 17. Current annual plans and ongoing promotions will remain at their existing prices until expiration.

Two years ago, the Premium monthly fee was already adjusted to $7.99, and Premium Plus to $13.99. Peacock subsequently added the Select tier while continuing to raise prices for its two main plans. Premium alone has increased by another $5 per month in just over two years.

Apple TV bundle remains unchanged for now

One of the unresolved questions concerns the bundle offer for Apple TV and Peacock.

Apple still lists Apple TV with Peacock Premium at $14.99 per month, and with Premium Plus at $19.99 per month. As we mentioned in April, on top of Apple TV's standalone monthly fee of $12.99, Peacock effectively costs an additional $2 or $7.

Currently, Apple's bundle page continues to show both prices unchanged.

However, subscribers of major entertainment services continue to face wave after wave of price hikes. Apple also joined the price increase trend last month, raising prices for Apple Music and Apple One.
